# Signal Selection

Not every observable correlates with failure; hunt variables that change when and only when things break.

## Contrast design

Compare success vs failure runs holding maximum context equal; the differing field is the lead.

## Eliminate confounders

If many things changed at once, isolate one variable per experiment when possible.

## Stop chasing noise

Abandon measurements that stay constant across outcomes for this failure mode.
